Tablet/mobile responsive but not pixel-matched (agreed scope).

Rules modal edge corrected to 5%/9500x (server playDice pays 95/winChance); Community wins Rank column added. Layout MIRROR BUG FOUND AND FIXED: widget rendered bet-panel-right/game-left at desktop (opposite of Figma) because the game area had no order class - unset order computes 0 and beat the panel lg:order-1. Proven by sampling the #122524 panel colour: Figma 7852px left vs 203 right; site was 5/3585 now 4927/8. Panel x 1093 -> 105. Roll spin slowed per user request (cycle 40->90ms, settle 300->500ms, MIN_SPIN_MS 900 floor that paces only the reveal, never settlement). Slider colours exact (#FF574A loss, #17F9B4 win, #56C7F3 handle); stat boxes 3 equal 292px cols; scale ticks 0-25-50-75-100 present. Section-band count 13 Figma vs 12 site. OUTSTANDING: no Practice-mode-off toggle (no fun/demo bet path exists in code - not faked, needs product decision); page 2705 vs 3294 tall because sample rows are honest empty states; footer Home-Help-Terms-Privacy is app chrome suppressed by Layout showFooter=false.

RESPONSIVE BUG FIXED: widget body was flex-row at every width while children carry order-2 lg:order-1, so on a nowrap row with a w-full bet panel the game area was crushed to ~16px at 768 and 375 - slider unusable on tablet/mobile. Now flex-col lg:flex-row; measured game area 674px at 768 and 289px at 375, desktop unchanged 972px right with controls left. Section order verified against absolute Figma coords: all 10 headings present, and About Skai Play x=124 / FAQ x=791 share y=3479 in Figma so the site pairing them at the same y is CORRECT two-column layout not a mis-order. Gaming typecheck: 2117 pre-existing baseline errors, exactly 1 introduced by this work (assurance icon style prop) and it is fixed.

FAIRNESS FIX: the On-Chain tab of ProvablyFairVerifier hardcoded valid:true and reported "verified" for ANY input (wrong block hash included), computing plain SHA-256 while its comment claimed keccak256. Authoritative chain algorithm is HMAC-SHA512 domain-separated + length-prefixed over clientSeed/betAmount/gameType/paramBlob/decidingHash/betID with roll=scaleRange(OutcomeToScaled(entropy 0:8),10000) - even the keeper PlayResponse doc misstates it. serverSeed/paramBlob/decidingHash never reach the client so no in-browser recompute can be truthful; panel now publishes the real algorithm + on-chain coordinates, informational styling, no fabricated roll. Legacy/POINTS tab untouched (genuinely compares). Typecheck 0 errors in that file.

Auto base panel verified in live render: Manual/Auto tabs, Bet amount with half-2X-Max, Balance, Number of Bets, Advanced toggle, and the Start Autobet CTA all present - matches the Figma 356x621 field list exactly. Probe note: Radix TabsTrigger exposes its value ("auto") as the accessible name, not the visible label, so getByRole tab name must match /^auto$/i.

Auto Advanced Displayed verified: toggling Advanced reveals On Win, On Loss, Stop on Profit, Stop on Loss plus the Reset and Increase By segmented controls - all six fields measured present in the live DOM after the switch is clicked.
Auto Advanced Extended: same advanced field set as 9065-1579 rendered from one component with the Advanced toggle on; verified in the same live-render pass.

Auto No Infinity state verified in code plus render: autoNumberOfBets defaults to "0" which is the infinite state, and the InfinityIcon renders under isInfiniteRun() - the empty-or-zero equals infinite convention matches the frame.

Desktop Pre Game verified by measurement: track height exactly 10px as Figma; scale ticks 0/25/50/75/100 at -1.3/24.3/50.0/75.6/101.2 percent of track vs Figma -0.0/24.9/49.9/74.8/99.9 - within ~1.3 percent at every stop, and the label row correctly overhangs the track (Figma 818 labels vs 836 track). Three stat cards Multiplier/Roll Over/Win Chance present as 3 equal columns. Split reads 50.5 percent vs Figma 48.4 percent because the fill tracks the LIVE Roll Over 50.50 while the mock shows a static 50.00 - correct behaviour not a delta.

Desktop Full Game: same 954x621 widget as Pre Game plus the result-pills row, which is present in the DOM (h-30px row) and renders its honest empty placeholder until a first roll lands. Verified in the same measured pass as 9069-959.

Desktop First Roll: static chrome matches (widget, slider, stat boxes, pills row present). The post-roll pill fill cannot be exercised locally - POINTS balance is 0 in the mock so a real roll returns an honest insufficient-balance reject, which itself proves bet validation. Deferred pending a funded rail.

Desktop Full Game Adjusted Slider: the red/green split is driven by the live Roll Over value (measured 50.5 percent fill for 50.50) rather than a fixed position, so an adjusted slider is the same component in a different state - the split tracking the value IS this frame.
Desktop Full Game Roll Over: the Roll Over stat card renders with its live value and refresh affordance; measured as one of three equal 292px columns matching the Figma 280px card in a 3-up row.
Desktop Full Game Win Chance: Win Chance card renders with the percent suffix and live value 49.4900; part of the same measured 3-column stat row.

Desktop Full Game Multiplier: Multiplier card renders live 1.9196 with its clear affordance - and that value is the 95 percent RTP figure (1.9196 x 49.49 = 0.950), so the state matches Figma AND the server economics.

Tablet 768 verified to the agreed scope (responsive and usable, not pixel-matched). Widget stacks full-width exactly as the Figma tablet frame does - panel-colour pixels balance L/R 13491/18513 on site vs 12273/13888 in Figma, i.e. both stacked not one-sided, confirming the flex-col lg:flex-row fix. Zero horizontal overflow at 768 and all 7 page sections present. Page is taller than the frame because sample tables render honest empty states.

Mobile 375 verified to the agreed scope. Zero horizontal overflow (no sideways scroll) and all 7 sections present - fairness sub-bar, community wins, more games, bets, about, licences, FAQ. Game area is full width (289px) after the stacking fix, up from the 16px crush the flex-row-at-every-width bug caused.

DESKTOP PAGE - CLOSED 2026-08-05, and closed with a REAL COPY DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED IN THIS PASS. Every previously recorded gap on this frame had already resolved to a standing product rule (the Practice-mode toggle is a permanent deliberate divergence - POINTS is the free-play path and no Skai title gets a Practice/Fun/Demo mode; the shorter page height is the no-mock-data policy rendering honest empty states; the suppressed footer is app chrome). * WHAT WAS ACTUALLY STILL BROKEN, and was invisible until the page was swept in a browser: /play/dice was the LAST game page still shipping the line 'New to crypto casinos? Try Dice in Fun Mode and join our vibrant online community today!' - i.e. it advertised a Fun Mode that does not exist, on the exact rule every other game page had already been corrected for. Blackjack, Chicken, Coinflip, Crash, Darts, Hi-Lo and Mines each carry a source comment recording that they DROP this line; DicePageSections.tsx:404 still rendered it. Removed, with the same note as its siblings. Re-verified in-browser at WIDTH=1440: all seven page regions present, 0px horizontal overflow, no error boundary, and the forbidden-string sweep is now clean where it previously flagged 'Fun Mode'. The multiplier economics on this family are settled and were not touched: the rail pays 95/winChance (DICE_RTP_PERCENT=95, live since points-game v99 on 2026-08-05T01:36Z) and the panel prints the multiplier the amount was computed from, off real state, not the frames' stale 1.9800.

CROSS-FILE NODE-ID COLLISION, not a dice screen - deferred and flagged rather than built. This id sits in dice.nodes.txt at line 3, wedged between 2713-3937 (Directory), 2713-3943 (Breakpoint), 2738-28626 (Rectangle 147) and two more Breakpoints - i.e. surrounded entirely by Skai-Games canvas furniture - yet dice.titles.tsv gives it the title 'Skai > Home > Add > upload image > conversation 4 1VH (1440 x 900px)', and the SAME bare id appears in home.nodes.txt line 348 with the identical title. That is exactly the collision SCHEMA.md warns about: node-ids are unique only WITHIN a file, and the schema's own worked example (6330-54594, home scaffolding in Skai-Web-App and a dice Breakpoint in Skai-Games) is two lines below this one in the very same list. So the TITLE is Skai-Web-App's and cannot be trusted to describe whatever Skai-Games node carries this id; on its neighbours' evidence that node is more canvas furniture. Deliberately NOT deleted from dice.nodes.txt - removing a node id is a structural catalog edit that could hide a real frame, and the honest record is that this entry's title is unreliable. It is the ONLY dice frame with no verdict, and it is a cataloguing artifact rather than unbuilt dice work, so it does not hold the family open. Worth a titles re-harvest against M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM to settle what the Skai-Games node actually is.
